name: getmachineaccountquota
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Read the ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota value from Active Directory via ADSI

name: addmachineaccount
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Add a rogue machine account to Active Directory via ADSI

parameters.name: computername
parameters.description: SAM account name for the new computer, without the trailing '$'

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for the new machine account. Leave empty to generate a random 32-character password.

name: delmachineaccount
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Delete a computer account from Active Directory via ADSI

parameters.name: computername
parameters.description: SAM account name of the computer to delete, without the trailing '$'

name: askcreds
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Prompt the logged-on user for credentials with a Windows credential dialog

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Reason shown in the credential prompt. Defaults to 'Restore Network Connection'.

name: cve-2022-26923
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: ADCS privilege escalation (CVE-2022-26923): add a machine account with a spoofed dNSHostName

parameters.name: computername
parameters.description: SAM account name for the new computer, without the trailing '$'

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for the new machine account. Leave empty to generate a random 32-character password.

name: domaininfo
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Enumerate Active Directory domain information (name, GUID, SID, DCs, FSMO roles) via ADSI

name: findprochandle
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Find processes holding a handle to the named process using direct system calls

parameters.name: process
parameters.description: Target process name, e.g. lsass.exe

name: findmodule
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Find processes with a specific module loaded using direct system calls

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Module name to search for, e.g. clr.dll

name: kerbhash
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Hash a password into Kerberos keys (RC4-HMAC, AES128/256-CTS-HMAC-SHA1, DES-CBC-MD5)

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Cleartext password to hash

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: sAMAccountName the password belongs to

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Fully qualified domain name, e.g. corp.local

name: kerberoast
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Enumerate SPN-enabled accounts or request crackable TGS-REP service tickets

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: list = enumerate SPN-enabled accounts, roast = request TGS tickets. The -no-aes variants skip AES-only accounts.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: sAMAccountName filter (wildcards allowed). Default: * (all accounts). Roasting without a filter is OPSEC-unsafe.

name: klist
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: List, purge, or request Kerberos tickets from the current logon session

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: empty = list cached tickets, purge = delete all tickets, get = request a service ticket for the SPN below

parameters.name: spn
parameters.description: Service principal name to request when command=get, e.g. cifs/dc01.corp.local

name: lapsdump
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Dump the LAPS password stored on a computer object in Active Directory

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Hostname or IP of the computer whose LAPS password to read

name: petitpotam
author: Cornelis de Plaa, b4rtik (Outflank)
comment: Coerce a Windows host into authenticating via MS-EFSRPC (PetitPotam)

parameters.name: capture_server
parameters.description: IP address or hostname of the listener that receives the coerced authentication

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: Host to coerce (IP address or hostname)

name: psc
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Show processes with established TCP or RDP connections

name: psk
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Enumerate the Windows kernel and loaded driver modules, flagging security products

name: psm
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Show detailed information about one process (modules, handles, TCP connections)

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Process ID to inspect

name: psw
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Show window titles of processes with active windows

name: psx
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: List all running processes with a summary of installed security products

parameters.name: extended
parameters.description: 0 = summary (default), 1 = detailed output

name: psxx
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: List all running processes with detailed module and security product information

parameters.name: extended
parameters.description: 0 = summary, 1 = detailed output (default)

name: reconad
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Run a custom LDAP filter against Active Directory via ADSI and print selected attributes

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: Query selector; always 'custom' for this command (the reconad-* variants fix it internally)

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: LDAP filter, e.g. (&(objectClass=user)(objectCategory=person)(sAMAccountName=*admin*))

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated LDAP attributes to return, or -all for every attribute

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of results; 0 means no limit

parameters.name: usegc
parameters.description: 1 = query the Global Catalog (GC), 0 = query the domain (LDAP)

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: server:port to query; -noserver uses the DC discovered from the current domain

name: reconad-users
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Query Active Directory user objects via ADSI and print selected attributes

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: Query selector; fixed to 'users'

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: Username or wildcard pattern, e.g. *admin*

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated LDAP attributes to return, or -all for every attribute

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of results; 0 means no limit

parameters.name: usegc
parameters.description: 1 = query the Global Catalog (GC), 0 = query the domain (LDAP)

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: server:port to query; -noserver uses the current domain DC

name: reconad-groups
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Query Active Directory group objects via ADSI and print selected attributes

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: Query selector; fixed to 'groups'

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: Group name or wildcard pattern, e.g. *admin*

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated LDAP attributes to return, or -all for every attribute

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of results; 0 means no limit

parameters.name: usegc
parameters.description: 1 = query the Global Catalog (GC), 0 = query the domain (LDAP)

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: server:port to query; -noserver uses the current domain DC

name: reconad-computers
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Query Active Directory computer objects via ADSI and print selected attributes

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: Query selector; fixed to 'computers'

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: Computer name or wildcard pattern, e.g. *srv*

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated LDAP attributes to return, or -all for every attribute

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of results; 0 means no limit

parameters.name: usegc
parameters.description: 1 = query the Global Catalog (GC), 0 = query the domain (LDAP)

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: server:port to query; -noserver uses the current domain DC

name: smbinfo
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Get remote system version information with NetWkstaGetInfo (no SMB port scan)

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Remote IP address or hostname

name: sprayad
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Password-spray Active Directory accounts over Kerberos or LDAP

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password to spray against every candidate account

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: sAMAccountName filter for targeted accounts (wildcards allowed). Default: *

parameters.name: authservice
parameters.description: empty = authenticate with Kerberos, ldap = use an LDAP bind

name: startwebclient
author: Cornelis de Plaa, Stan Hegt (Outflank)
comment: Start the WebClient service in the current user context through a service trigger

name: wdtoggle
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Patch LSASS to enable WDigest credential caching and bypass Credential Guard

name: winver
author: Cornelis de Plaa (Outflank)
comment: Display the Windows version, build number, and update build revision
